ext.description: Claude Code token usage & cost in VSCode status bar
config.title: Claude Status
config.logging.enabled.desc: Enable diagnostic logging (Output panel + log file). Default: true.
config.logging.verbose.desc: Verbose logging — when true, all debug detail is logged (recommended for CK's own extensions). When false, the floor is set by logging.level. Default: true.
config.logging.level.desc: Minimum log level when logging.verbose is false. One of debug, info, warn, error. Ignored while verbose is true (which forces debug).
config.logging.toFile.desc: Also write logs to a file on disk (in addition to the Output panel). Default: true.
config.logging.filePath.desc: Custom log file path. Leave empty to use the default (~/.claude/logs/vscode-claude-status.log). The file rotates to .1 at 5 MB.
config.displayMode.desc: Status bar display mode: utilization percentage or USD cost.
config.statusBar.alignment.desc: Position of the status bar item.
config.statusBar.showProjectCost.desc: Show current project cost in the status bar.
config.cache.ttlSeconds.desc: Freshness window in seconds. The local statusline JSON is treated as fresh when modified within this window; older reads show a staleness indicator. (Legacy name — this no longer throttles any network call.)
config.rateLimitApi.enabled.desc: Enable showing rate-limit utilization (5h/7d %). Data is read locally from the Claude Code statusline JSON (claudeStatus.statusJson.path) on every refresh — no Anthropic API call is made (the old consumer-OAuth API path was banned Jan 2026). When disabled, only local token cost is shown. Default: true.
config.realtime.enabled.desc: Legacy toggle. Rate-limit data is now read from the local statusline JSON on every refresh regardless of this setting, so it no longer changes behaviour. Retained for settings-compatibility.
config.statusJson.path.desc: Path to the Claude Code statusline JSON that carries local rate-limit data (5h/7d used %, reset times). Read on every refresh — no network call. scope:machine is a security control: a workspace .vscode/settings.json cannot redirect this file read. Default: /tmp/claude-status.json.
config.budget.dailyUsd.desc: Daily budget in USD. Set to null to disable.
config.budget.weeklyUsd.desc: Weekly budget in USD. Set to null to disable.
config.budget.alertThresholdPercent.desc: Show budget warning when usage exceeds this percentage of the budget.
config.notifications.rateLimitWarning.de: Show notification when rate limit is approaching.
config.notifications.rateLimitWarningThr: Show rate limit warning this many minutes before exhaustion.
config.notifications.budgetWarning.desc: Show notification when budget threshold is exceeded.
config.heatmap.days.desc: Number of days shown in the usage heatmap.
config.credentials.path.desc: Custom path to Claude credentials file. Leave null to use default (~/.claude/.credentials.json).
config.claudeProvider.desc: Claude provider type. Controls whether rate limit percentages or cost is shown in the status bar.
config.claudeProvider.auto: Auto-detect: checks credentials file, then AWS/API key environment variables.
config.claudeProvider.claudeAi: Claude.ai subscription — shows rate limit utilization (5h window, 7d window if available).
config.claudeProvider.awsBedrock: AWS Bedrock — no rate limits, shows token cost only.
config.claudeProvider.apiKey: Anthropic API key — no rate limits, shows token cost only.
config.pricing.inputPerMillion.desc: Cost per 1M input tokens in USD. Default: $3.00 (Claude Sonnet 4.x). Update this if Anthropic changes pricing.
config.pricing.outputPerMillion.desc: Cost per 1M output tokens in USD. Default: $15.00 (Claude Sonnet 4.x). Update this if Anthropic changes pricing.
config.pricing.cacheReadPerMillion.desc: Cost per 1M cache-read tokens in USD. Default: $0.30 (Claude Sonnet 4.x). Update this if Anthropic changes pricing.
config.pricing.cacheCreatePerMillion.des: Cost per 1M cache-creation tokens in USD. Default: $3.75 (Claude Sonnet 4.x). Update this if Anthropic changes pricing.
